# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 19 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 34 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_019_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 19

**1** Jesus said: "Blessed is the one who existed before existing.

**2** If you become my disciples and listen to my words, these very stones will serve you.

**3** You have five trees in Paradise — they never change between summer and winter, and their leaves never fall.

**4** Whoever comes to know them will never die."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Existed before existing" — "came into being" rendered as simpler "existed"; the paradox is stark
- "These very stones" — "very" adds emphasis to the surprising claim
- "Never change... never fall" — the eternal constancy of Paradise rendered with "never" for emphasis
- "Will never die" — consistent PNEUMA rendering of the death-promise
